overview: The Committee of the Whole deliberated on amendments to the Medford Standard Compensation Ordinance to establish wage and benefit floors for contracted service workers. The council also addressed significant disputes with the administration regarding access to neutral legal counsel and the confidentiality of draft legislation.

items.title: Standard Compensation Ordinance Amendment
items.summary: The council discussed a redlined draft of an ordinance intended to set fair wage standards, labor peace requirements, and worker retention policies for city-contracted janitorial and security services. Debate centered on policy differences between a draft provided by city legal counsel and an expanded version proposed by council leadership.

items.title: Request for Legal Advice Policy
items.summary: Approved a motion requesting that the administration provide a formal written policy detailing the procedures for the City Council and individual members to request and receive legal advice. This followed a dispute over whether draft legal reviews are subject to attorney-client privilege or public record.

items.title: Public Participation
items.summary: Residents spoke in favor of hiring an in-house city solicitor to provide independent legal guidance and suggested technical adjustments to the contract transition timelines in the proposed ordinance.

items.title: Referral of Standard Compensation Ordinance
items.summary: Approved a motion to report the updated redlined version of the ordinance to the regular City Council session for final consideration.

subject: Standard Compensation Ordinance and Legal Counsel Policy
